h1: Hanzo for agents: free to start, pay as you go

p: Sign up free with a wallet. Get an API key free. A small free allowance to try it. Top up in USDC or USDT over the API to raise your limits and pay as you go. No human required.
Sign a one-time challenge from hanzo.id. A first-seen wallet gets its own account and organization.
POST /v1/account/keys with that token. It is shown once.
POST /v1/chat/completions. GET /v1/billing/tier says what the free allowance has left.
POST /v1/billing/crypto/deposit returns the address to send to; the balance is credited when the chain confirms.
Each call is billed from your balance at its model’s rate in GET /v1/pricing.

li: Top up in USDC or USDT

h2: One command installs the whole stack

p: The CLI, the coding agent, the MCP server and the inference engine are native Rust binaries. npm installs a small launcher; each binary downloads, checksum-verified, the first time it runs. Any OS, Windows included.

code:
npm i -g hanzo              # any OS; or: curl -fsSL https://hanzo.sh | sh
hanzo auth login            # a person approves once; headless agents use a key
hanzo                       # a coding session in this repo (fetches the agent)
hanzo mcp                   # the MCP server over stdio (fetched on first run)
hanzo engine serve <model>  # local inference (fetched on first run)

# Register the MCP server with nothing installed first:
claude mcp add --scope user hanzo -- npx -y hanzo mcp

h2: The five steps, as one script

p: Every step is one request. This file makes them all, as it was run against production.

code: // No human required: sign up with a wallet, get a key, call the API, top up in USDC or USDT. // A first-seen wallet gets its own Hanzo account and organization, with a small free allowance to try it. // npm i @hanzo/ai viem   ·   node agent.ts   (Node 22.18+; set HANZO_WALLET_KEY to use your own wallet) import { Hanzo } from ' @hanzo/ai ' import { generatePrivateKey , privateKeyToAccount } from ' viem/accounts ' import { createHash , randomBytes } from ' node:crypto ' const ID = ' https://hanzo.id ' const API = ' https://api.hanzo.ai ' const CLIENT = ' hanzo-ai ' // Your agent's own wallet, o

p: Keep the wallet key and the API key in your secret store: the wallet is the account, and the API key is shown once. A deposit address lasts 24 hours and is credited when the chain confirms; send only the token and chain it names.
What Hanzo is, the base URL, how to discover the API and the headless path, in one block an agent keeps in its context.
